title: docs(skills): objectui guides stop teaching the retired @object-ui/plugin-ai and vscode-extension; the project-setup eval refuses the retired package
body:
Fixes #27048
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectui 技能包的三处文档不再教已退役的 `@object-ui/plugin-ai`(示例 package.json、插件目录表、README 插件清单),README 工具行去掉已移出仓库的 `vscode-extension`;project-setup 评测新增一条拒收断言。
- 为什么改:AI 作者照抄 objectui 安装指南时,会装上一个已退役、不再发布新版本的包,或被引向一个已不存在的 VS Code 扩展;这是技能包该挡住的漂移,评测现在能给这种回答扣分。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档与评测数据、不动任何运行时代码;每个文件的 token 数都下降,无上限变更;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectui/evals/project-setup.json`(新增 `must_not_contain`,并由同文件内删去的一句 `apps/console` 指引付账)、`skills/objectui/README.md`(插件数 19 改 18)、`skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`(AI 行只留 `plugin-chatbot`)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期见 `project-setup.md 2718 / 2727 (-9)`、`page-builder.md 3407 / 3411 (-4)` 且末行为绿勾。
- 需要你做的:作为 Tier H 技能面,席位复核通过后由维护者批准(APPROVED)落地。

## What changes

- `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`: the sample `package.json` no longer lists `"@object-ui/plugin-ai": "latest",`. The block stays valid JSON: the line it sat in was a middle entry, and `plugin-chatbot` stays last without a trailing comma.
- `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`: the AI row of the plugin catalog is `| AI | plugin-chatbot |`. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` is in the workspace and published (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` 18.2.0, not private), so the row stays and no successor is invented.
- `skills/objectui/README.md`: the package snapshot's plugin list drops `ai` (18 plugins, not 19). That matches the 18 `ui/packages/plugin-*` directories on `origin/main` 968925c8 name for name. The tooling line drops `vscode-extension`. PR #27275 removed `ui/packages/vscode-extension` and added no package (58 files: 26 removed, 32 modified, 0 added), so nothing replaces it.
- `skills/objectui/evals/project-setup.json`: case 1 (the full Vite + React setup, whose expected output names `package.json` dependencies) gains `must_not_contain: "@object-ui/plugin-ai"`. That case's prompt and expected output do not spell the refused string. The added bytes are paid inside this file: case 3's rubric drops the trailing clause ", the way apps/console/src/index.css does". That is a workspace-only pointer, and `skills/objectui/rules/styling.md` L306 still teaches it.
- `.changeset/27048-objectui-guides-drop-plugin-ai.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, which carries both declaration lines.

The three retired AI node types (`ai-form-assist`, `ai-recommendations`, `nl-query`) are refused by name in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/ai.zod.ts`. `git grep` finds 0 hits for them under `skills/` before and after this change, so no guide teaches them.

## Tests

Token budget (the ratchet's `ceil(bytes / 4)`, per file; ceilings unchanged):

| File | Tokens before / after (ceiling) | Lines before / after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` | 2727 / 2718 (2727) | 350 / 349 |
| `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` | 3411 / 3407 (3411) | 349 / 349 |
| `skills/objectui/README.md` | 735 / 729 (735) | 64 / 64 |
| `skills/objectui/evals/project-setup.json` | 786 / 784 (786) | 58 / 59 |
| `skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json` | 560 / 560 (untouched: no case covers the plugin table) | 56 / 56 |

- The eval string costs 34 bytes (comma, newline, 10-space indent, the 22-byte quoted string). Case 3's dropped clause frees 41 bytes, so the file nets -7 bytes and -2 tokens.
- Whole-package reading: the sum of every `SKILL.md` under `skills/` is 4614 lines before and 4614 after (none touched). The `skills/objectui` bundle is 202387 bytes before and 202307 after, and 5427 lines before and after.
- `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` exits 0. It only checks the shape of a `must_not_contain` entry and never scores it against the guides, so it neither reads nor refuses the new string.
- `check:skill-identifier-liveness` exits 0 before (`origin/main` 968925c8) and after. Its citation list holds 0 `plugin-ai` sites, so the gate could not see this drift in either direction.

## Acceptance notes

- The README plugin-list line (`Plugins (19)` to `Plugins (18)`, dropping `ai`) is a fourth stale line beyond the card's three. It is in the claimed file and is the card's exact subject (the README teaching `plugin-ai`), so it rides here.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 34 unbuilt packages) and is NOT MEASURED locally. This diff touches no built package, so a whole-workspace build was not worth it. CI's Lint and Repo Gates run it on a built tree.
